package_exclusions.reason: Commercial SDK/application provisioning remains external to the public asset.
Runtime-only deployment policy, not a claim that every static library/header is legally nonredistributable. CUDA Attachment A includes some exceptions; runtime NVRTC DLLs remain allowed.

release_gaps.detail: Exact FFmpeg core source and provider configure/library-version records are retained, but matching source archives, patches and build/install recipes for the statically linked external libraries are not verified. The external_libraries table enumerates every supplied version; libbluray/libcaca/libmodplug/libmysofa are enabled but absent from that version list.
alternatives: Obtain the complete corresponding-source/build bundle for these unchanged binaries and publish it alongside the executable asset.
Defer the bundled-binary prerelease; publish self-authored source and this dependency manifest first.

release_gaps.detail: Official binary ZIP contains zero license/notice resources. Own source, embedded licenses, Qt 6.11.1 source, CGAL 6.2 source and exact registry recipes are retained. Complete per-DLL copyright notices, source/build/patch binding (including GMP/MPFR/SuiteSparse/GCC/Qt dependencies) and CGAL effective-license assessment are still missing.
alternatives: Recover matching vcpkg installed/share copyright, status/build receipts and covered source/patch archives for the official artifact; retain Qt replacement rights.
Defer the binary asset; a dependency-free source distribution can identify exact externally provisioned tools without deleting any feature implementation.

release_gaps.detail: No explicit grant/terms covering redistribution of alexnet-owt-7be5be79.pth in this public offline package has been verified. Code and dataset licenses are recorded separately.
alternatives: Obtain applicable provider terms or permission for this exact checkpoint.
Defer offline binary publication; an explicitly documented user-provisioned model artifact is a separate release choice, not an automatic feature removal.

release_gaps.detail: No explicit grant/terms covering redistribution of maskrcnn_resnet50_fpn_v2_coco-73cbd019.pth in this public offline package has been verified.
alternatives: Obtain applicable provider terms or permission for this exact checkpoint.
Defer offline binary publication; any user-provisioned-weight release must be selected and documented by the release owner.

release_gaps.detail: plyfile.py is GPL-3.0-or-later and directly imported by the engine. Its exact source/COPYING are retained. The effective distribution terms for the combined program, including interaction with proprietary NVIDIA runtimes, have not been established; do not label every included component Apache-2.0.
alternatives: Determine and satisfy the applicable GPL distribution/source terms while preserving third-party license boundaries.
Publish self-authored source first and defer the binary asset pending resolution; this task does not replace or remove PLY I/O.

release_gaps.detail: CUDA 12.9 Attachment A and cuDNN 9.10.2 DLL redistribution provisions are identified and retained. Final package must retain the separate agreements/notices and consistent application distribution terms. Binary runtime grant does not license an entire toolkit or resolve combined GPL obligations.
alternatives: Include the retained runtime agreements/notices and verify the final package distribution terms and exact DLL inventory.

release_gaps.detail: CPython 3.10.22 source and installed core/license resources are retained. Complete standalone-build resource provenance for retained Tcl/Tk/OpenSSL/libffi/Windows CRT components has not been bound to the final pruned package. Absence of final binaries prevents closing this item.
alternatives: Inventory the actual final runtime and retain the corresponding vendor notices/redistribution evidence for each native component that remains.

reproducibility.fetch: Only pinned public source archive URLs are downloaded; provider response snapshots are immutable evidence retained in the source bundle.
reproducibility.materialize: Notice bytes can be recovered from hash-verified archive members or the exact package resources. Existing evidence is never overwritten.
reproducibility.verify: Default mode exits nonzero for open gaps, missing/corrupt resources, unreviewed binary/model identities, private SDK or absent final package. --evidence-only validates gathered bytes without approving publication.
reproducibility.publication: Publish a source/notice bundle with this manifest and its hashes next to the binary asset only after gaps are resolved. Keep separate licenses and terms; a bare upstream link is not recorded as complete corresponding-source delivery.
reproducibility.bundle: Export only manifest-listed public artifacts, the manifest/verifier and a hash inventory into a new non-overlapping directory. Working scripts, private paths and unlisted files are excluded.
